Then ONLY ONE compact clickable sound summary row directly beneath the graph card: small waveform icon, "Sonidos", "30 eventos · 12 min", chevron right. Board should convincingly show the navigation relationship through a very subtle small arrow in the gutter. Do not invent extra features or additional tabs. statistics.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create the STATISTICS companion board for the new Alarma diary design. Input image 1 is the NEW DIARY VISUAL STYLE reference to match faithfully; image 2 is the old statistics screenshot to redesign, retaining functionality but replacing dense text tables with clear compact charts. Landscape design board with TWO full front-on iPhone screens with realistic 402:874 aspect, thin subtle dark frame, no hands or perspective. Pale stone board, warm cream screen, elegant dark desaturated green serif headings, readable modern sans-serif labels, terracotta accents, rounded off-white paper cards, sage / dusty blue / lavender sleep charts. Title outside phones "Estadísticas · Tu descanso, de un vistazo". Subtitle "Propuesta visual · Datos de ejemplo". Everything in Spanish, crisp and well spaced, visually calm and implementable.
Both phones represent the SAME statistics page opened from the chart icon next to the diary calendar: LEFT initial viewport, RIGHT after scrolling lower. Keep exact same modal header on both: "Estadísticas" elegant compact title and small circular X close button. Tiny context "7–13 octubre". Segmented control "7 días | 30 días | 90 días | Todo" with 7 días selected. NO bottom navigation in this modal; bottom home indicator only. Label outside phones left "Vista principal", right "Al seguir bajando".
LEFT content:
Main compact card "Tu semana" with a large "7 h 12" and caption "Sueño medio · Salud"; small sage trend "↑ 18 min" and "respecto a la semana anterior". A handsome 7-day rounded vertical bar chart for nightly sleep, muted sage/dark teal bars, faint horizontal ticks labelled 0 h / 4 h / 8 h, x labels 7 8 9 10 11 12 13. Small paired compact stats below "En cama 7 h 52" and "Calidad media 81 / 100". Keep quality not a medical diagnosis, example data only.
Second card "Tus horarios" with a beautiful little 7-day sleep timing visualization: horizontal thin overnight intervals for each date aligned between 22:00 and 09:00, varied bedtimes/wakeups around 23:32 / 07:24. Under plot two concise columns "Acostarte 23:32" and "Despertarte 07:24".
Third smaller card "Regularidad" with a visually simple thin distribution/range strip and large "±24 min", caption "Variación de tu hora de acostarte". Keep fully visible.
RIGHT content below same header and range, representing continued scroll:
Card "Fases del sueño" with a generous ring chart, central "7 h 12" "de sueño"; ring sleep colors sage light, teal deep, dusty blue REM; wake shown separate lavender small horizontal bar beneath. Clear compact 2x2 legend: "Ligero 4 h 05", "Profundo 1 h 25", "REM 1 h 42", "Vigilia 40 min". Tiny "Promedio por noche · Salud". No claim phases derived from sound.
Below, two modest metric tiles side by side, matching style: "Para dormirte" "18 min"; "Despertares" "2 por noche".
Then "Cómo te has despertado" paper card with the exact five charming round pastel face icons from reference, each with count below, in one horizontal row. Counts 0, 1, 2, 3, 1, sum 7; "En calma" as small leading caption. No excessive text.
Finally ONE compact clickable card "Sonidos de la semana", small waveform icon and right chevron; beneath title one short line "Ronquidos 9 min/noche · Ruidos 4 min/noche". NO list of individual recordings or repeated category rows. A subtle bottom caption "7 noches registradas". Chart hierarchy and generous breathing space, readable mobile text. Every statistic must be meaningfully labelled; no generic squiggles, no extra features, no giant prose disclaimers, no rewards, subscriptions or badges. Use the reference's refined notebook aesthetic and match its actual face illustrations. This is a design concept with invented example data, not an actual new implemented app.
